title: Universal Unit Converter
description: Convert metric and imperial units locally for Length, Weight, Temperature, Area, Volume, Time, and Speed.

faq.q: How does local unit conversion work?
faq.a: CoolTools processes mathematical formulas and conversion factor constants entirely locally in your browser memory.
We support Length (meters, feet, etc.), Weight (kilograms, pounds, etc.), Temperature (Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin), Area, Volume, Time, and Speed.
